method: 20 distinct (14 CFR part, 49 U.S.C. section) pairs that resolve in the 2024 Code, drawn with seed 20261128 by usc_measure.py; each authority line was re-read to confirm that the number is cited there as a section of 49 U.S.C., alone or as the end of a range.
note: All 20 numbers stand in the authority line as sections of 49 U.S.C.; 6 are the first or last section of a cited range. The check confirms the citation was read correctly. It does not judge whether the statute section is the legal basis for every rule in the part: an authority line lists sections for the whole part (14 CFR part 120, drug and alcohol testing, lists 49 U.S.C. 41721, reports on incidents involving animals).
